Name: talkohlooeys' Portraits (Retired)
Author: talkohlooeys
Description:
Please feel free to make and upload any edits you want! No need to ask for permission, it's all good.

Stardew Valley Expanded characters continued by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/126402198]1oxnes[/url].
Content Patcher version created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/40356210]Fuzzlepuzzle
[/url][url=https://talkohstardew.blogspot.com/]Blog for alternate & in-progress portraits[/url]

[size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904?tab=description]Seasonal portraits page[/url]﻿

About:[/b]
[/size]
I mainly started doing this as a fun project for myself but figured I'd share it in case anyone else wants to try these out. There are a lot of over-the-top and goofy things in this set and you might feel like it doesn't fit in very well with the world of Stardew Valley, so it's probably not for everyone.
This is my first time doing something like this so if you have any feedback or advice to give, or if I missed something, please go ahead!

[b]There are two versions of this mod:
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url] (which uses Content Patcher)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿
